spanish: Y hizo las tablas al mishkán: veinte tablas al lado de Negev, al Temán.

findings.issue: Common noun H4908 is left untranslated as mishkán.
Common noun H5045 is rendered as the proper name Negev, closing the open south/region sense.
Common noun H8486 with directional suffix is rendered as the proper name Temán, closing the open southward sense.

notes: The 3ms qal wayyiqtol, definite then indefinite boards, and twenty match the tokens.
